import struct
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('{TARGET}')
blob=p.read_bytes()
# minimal ELF64 parsing to map vaddr->offset using PT_LOAD
EI_CLASS=blob[4]
assert EI_CLASS==2
end='<' if blob[5]==1 else '>'
# e_phoff at 0x20, e_phentsize 0x36, e_phnum 0x38
(e_phoff,)=struct.unpack_from(end+'Q',blob,0x20)
(e_phentsize,)=struct.unpack_from(end+'H',blob,0x36)
(e_phnum,)=struct.unpack_from(end+'H',blob,0x38)
PT_LOAD=1
segs=[]
for i in range(e_phnum):
    off=e_phoff+i*e_phentsize
    p_type,=struct.unpack_from(end+'I',blob,off)
    if p_type!=PT_LOAD: continue
    p_offset,p_vaddr,p_paddr,p_filesz,p_memsz,p_flags,p_align=struct.unpack_from(end+'QQQQQQQ',blob,off+8)
    segs.append((p_vaddr,p_vaddr+p_filesz,p_offset,p_flags))
# function to map vaddr to file off

def v2o(v):
    for v0,v1,o,fl in segs:
        if v0<=v<v1:
            return o+(v-v0)
    raise KeyError(hex(v))
addr=0x402050
n=0x2a # guess; but length 27 needed
# let's take 64 bytes
off=v2o(addr)
print('fileoff',hex(off))
chunk=blob[off:off+64]
print('hex',chunk[:64].hex())
# find null-terminated string from that chunk
s=chunk.split(b'\x00',1)[0]
print('asciistr',s)
print('len_before_nul',len(s))
# print first 27 bytes too
print('first27',list(chunk[:27]))

table=[108, 60, 253, 186, 63, 216, 84, 249, 151, 14, 164, 33, 246, 107, 2, 166, 37, 220, 119, 243, 136, 49, 252, 204, 9, 94, 221]
edx=0x2a
inp=[]
for b in table:
    x=b ^ (edx & 0xff)
    inp.append(x)
    edx=(edx + x) & 0xffffffff
print('edx_end',hex(edx))
print('bytes',inp)
print('ascii',bytes(inp))
# show printable with escapes
print('repr',bytes(inp))
